resource_visual_inspection.source: Direct pixel inspection of original Data/GameInter.wil Frame 200 (256×512 WIL source; visible UI is clipped to the constructor window).
observations: The artwork contains a vertical character/status panel with empty equipment-slot silhouettes; the slot labels are not baked into Frame 200.
The visible slot artwork must therefore be combined with runtime item graphics and the 11-record paint loop; a static screenshot of Frame 200 alone cannot name the equipment positions.
The close control and the secondary status control are separate child resources (161/162 and 171/172), not part of the slot-record loop.

Frames 171/172 are the attribute-view face pair of the view-toggle button (see child_controls / hit_rects / closed_notes). Pixel inspection (original GameInter.wil): both 36x36 and fully opaque; 171 = dark-bordered face with a bright plus (+) core (horizontal bar rows 12-13, vertical bar near col 21); 172 = block + vertical bar composite (left block rows 3-11, horizontal mid-bar rows 12-13, vertical band cols 21-22 rows 5-26) — a plus/minus-style pair.

Frame 200 also contains no baked-in attribute label artwork (pixel scan found no text-like columns); all attribute labels are drawn at runtime by 0x0044BC80 with GBK strings from .rdata (0x0047C638..0x0047C74C).

Map-rebuild start byte [map+0x124] semantics PRIMARY-STATIC (2026-08-11, Finding 266): the byte is the header byte at offset 0x14 of the loaded '.\\Map\\%s.map' file (format string 0x47C404). Chain: map-enter caller 0x422B2B (lea ebp,[esi+0xF5200]; lea edx,[esp+0x14]; mov ecx,ebp; push edx; call 0x43B600) -> 0x43B600 copies the path into [ebx+4] -> CreateFileA (IAT 0x4760DC) -> 0x43B820 rep stosd zeroes [ebx+0x110..0x12B] -> ReadFile(hFile, [ebx+0x110], 0x1C) @0x43B68B is the SOLE writer of byte+0x124 (0x124 = 0x110+0x14; the only byte-sized [mem+0x124] access in .text is the read @0x43B772; the other 0x124 sites 0x41A210/0x41A2AA/0x434F1C/0x435557..0x435624/0x45A275 are unrelated object types). Formula @0x43B770-0x43B77C: mov al,[ebx+0x124]; mov cl,0xE; inc al; imul cl -> start=(byte+1)*14. Rebuild loop 0x43B7B2: 14 iterations, element = 0x5600FC+start*0x144, slot = 0x56B22C+start*0x104, push 1; call 0x4660E0 (mode 1); on failure 0x465FE0 dtor + push 0 mode-0 fallback. Dtor loop 0x43B75B always destroys el14..el69 (esi=0x5612B4, < 0x565994 = el70). Shipped maps (544 files under Map/, directories skipped) have header[0x14] in {0: 530 files, 1: 14 files}; type-1 (byte=1) maps = 4.map (32x32) and 41..44.map (144x144) - the earlier 800x800 claim was wrong; byte=4 (-> el70..83) and byte=8 (-> el126..139) appear in NO shipped map and are hypothetical only. Default when open fails = 0 (bss zeroed @0x43B820). Runtime consequence: every shipped map rebuilds only el14..el27 (byte 0) or el28..el41 (byte 1), mode 1.
